The Price of Ingenuity#002.src: Previously implemented locomotive models employ an engine with relatively low efficiency.
The Price of Ingenuity#002.dst: 기존 기관차 모델은 효율이 비교적 낮은 엔진을 사용한다.

The Price of Ingenuity#003.src: Rest for the night in you room in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#003.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있는 Steel Feather의 방에서 하룻밤 쉬세요.

The Price of Ingenuity#004.src: ...what. Where is it? W-where is it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#004.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#006.src: My bow, Yuman! Where is it? WHERE did you put it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#006.dst: 내 활 말이야, Yuman! 어디 있어? 어디다 뒀어?!
The Price of Ingenuity#006.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#007.src: Hey, hey, relax, jeez! It's over here, on the meeting table! It fell off your bed in the early morning, so I figured I'd put it somewhere safe!
The Price of Ingenuity#007.dst: 어이, 어이, 진정 좀 해! 여기 회의 탁자 위에 있어! 새벽에 네 침대에서 떨어졌길래 안전한 데 둔 거야!
The Price of Ingenuity#007.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#008.src: I didn't, like, snatch it off ya or anything! Sorry, man! My bad. I forgot you got like this.
The Price of Ingenuity#008.dst: 네 거 막 뺏어 간 건 아니야! 미안, 내 잘못이야. 네가 이러는 걸 깜빡했네.
The Price of Ingenuity#008.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#010.src: Sorry. For shouting at you. I... don't know what came over me.
The Price of Ingenuity#010.dst: 미안. 소리 질러서. 나... 내가 왜 그랬는지 모르겠어.
The Price of Ingenuity#010.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#011.src: Hey, it's all good! I get grouchy too when one of my bros moves my stuff without tellin' me! 'Kay, well, maybe not that grouchy, but- I sorta get it, is what I mean.
The Price of Ingenuity#011.dst: 에이, 괜찮아! 나도 형들이 말없이 내 물건 옮기면 짜증 나거든! 뭐, 그 정도로 짜증 내진 않지만- 대충 이해한다는 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#011.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#012.src: Mmh. Did I ever tell you about it back when I was staying here?
The Price of Ingenuity#012.dst: 음. 내가 전에 여기 묵을 때 그 얘기 한 적 있었나?
The Price of Ingenuity#012.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#013.src: Nah, don't think you ever did. You were still keepin' everyone an arm's length away back then, so I didn't want to push my luck.
The Price of Ingenuity#013.dst: 아니, 한 적 없을걸. 그땐 다들 멀찍이 떼어 놓고 지냈잖아. 그래서 괜히 캐묻지 않았지.
The Price of Ingenuity#013.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#014.src: Right... right. It's not even that big of a deal. My bow's just... important to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#014.dst: 그래... 그렇지. 사실 별일도 아니야. 그냥 내 활은... 나한테 소중해.
The Price of Ingenuity#014.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#015.src: Yes, I know I look silly walking around with the bulky thing all day! But I can't afford to lose it. I need it. I can't explain why, but I do.
The Price of Ingenuity#015.dst: 그래, 하루 종일 이 커다란 걸 들고 다니면 우스워 보이는 거 알아! 그래도 잃어버리면 안 돼. 필요해. 이유는 설명 못 하지만.
The Price of Ingenuity#015.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#016.src: Nah that's cool, man! If we're talkin' silly, just take a look at me! I fight using my GUITAR! How d'you get sillier than that?
The Price of Ingenuity#016.dst: 에이, 괜찮아! 우스운 걸로 치면 나를 봐! 난 '기타'로 싸운다고! 이보다 더 우스울 수 있냐?
The Price of Ingenuity#016.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#017.src: Pff, ha! What, do you just play bad music until your enemies give up? "Please, stop, I can't bear it! The melody's too discordant!"
The Price of Ingenuity#017.dst: 풉, 하! 뭐야, 적이 포기할 때까지 형편없는 연주라도 해? "제발 그만, 못 참겠어! 선율이 너무 엉망이야!"
The Price of Ingenuity#017.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#018.src: Hahahah! That'd be fun, I should try that! But nah, I just club 'em with it. Yus stuck some metal plates in, so it hurts more and doesn't break!
The Price of Ingenuity#018.dst: 하하하! 그거 재밌겠다, 해 봐야지! 근데 아니, 그냥 이걸로 후려쳐. Yus 형이 금속판을 넣어 줘서 더 아프고 안 부서져!
The Price of Ingenuity#018.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#019.src: Wow. You're right, that's way sillier than what I do. I've got to tell Zeph about this.
The Price of Ingenuity#019.dst: 와. 네 말이 맞네, 나보다 훨씬 우습다. Zeph한테 꼭 말해 줘야겠어.
The Price of Ingenuity#019.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#020.src: Woah, hey! You don't gotta do that, let him think I'm cool! But, uh, jokes aside. Feeling better?
The Price of Ingenuity#020.dst: 워, 잠깐! 그럴 필요 없잖아, 걔는 나 멋있는 줄 알게 둬! 근데, 어, 농담은 그만하고. 좀 나아졌어?
The Price of Ingenuity#020.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#022.src: Good! Cool, then you should wake up the rest of your gang. Quill said he'd be over soon, wanted to talk to you about something.
The Price of Ingenuity#022.dst: 좋아! 그럼 이제 나머지 친구들 깨워. Quill이 곧 온대. 너희한테 할 얘기가 있다더라.
The Price of Ingenuity#022.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#023.src: Wake up the other three members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#026.src: Morning, Sui! She's not exactly a... morning person. Guess I forgot to warn you!
The Price of Ingenuity#026.dst: 좋은 아침, Sui! 얘가 좀... 아침형 인간이 아니거든. 미리 말해 준다는 걸 깜빡했네!
The Price of Ingenuity#026.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#030.src: Why'd you wake me up? Um, this early.
The Price of Ingenuity#030.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#033.src: Um... is he... expecting me to, ha, prepare, breakfast? Oh, no...
The Price of Ingenuity#033.dst: 음... 그 사람이... 나더러, 하, 아침을, 차리라는 거야? 아, 안 돼...
The Price of Ingenuity#033.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#035.src: And there she goes. Well, no stopping her anxieties now! Might as well just let her get it out of her system.
The Price of Ingenuity#035.dst: 또 시작이네. 뭐, 이제 걱정은 못 말려! 그냥 실컷 털어놓게 두는 게 낫지.
The Price of Ingenuity#035.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#038.src: Ah, yes, I had overheard! I assume he has some work for us then.
The Price of Ingenuity#038.dst: 아, 네, 들었어요! 그럼 우리에게 맡길 일이 있나 보군요.
The Price of Ingenuity#038.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#039.src: Allow me to go freshen up, and then I will join you.
The Price of Ingenuity#039.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#040.src: Surprisingly so, yes! These beds were much more comfortable than I had anticipated...
The Price of Ingenuity#040.dst: 놀랍게도 그래요! 이 침대가 생각보다 훨씬 편하더군요...
The Price of Ingenuity#040.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#041.src: However... hm. I appear to have been afflicted with repeating night terrors.
The Price of Ingenuity#041.dst: 다만... 흠. 밤마다 악몽에 시달리는 것 같아요.
The Price of Ingenuity#041.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#042.src: Reality is setting in, in a sense. Returning to the {p} now is out of the question. We cannot come home until the deed is done.
The Price of Ingenuity#042.dst: 어떤 의미로는 현실이 실감 나는 거죠. 이제 {p}(으)로 돌아가는 건 불가능해요. 일을 끝내기 전엔 집에 못 가요.
The Price of Ingenuity#042.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#043.src: It does weigh on me a little. We have made new friends and allies here, but this is the furthest away I have ever been from home.
The Price of Ingenuity#043.dst: 조금 마음이 무겁긴 해요. 여기서 새 친구와 동료를 사귀었지만, 집에서 이렇게 멀리 온 건 처음이거든요.
The Price of Ingenuity#043.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#044.src: Hm. I know the feeling, Mora. If it helps, it never really goes away, but it becomes... lighter. Easier to deal with.
The Price of Ingenuity#044.dst: 흠. 나도 그 기분 알아, Mora. 위로가 될지 모르지만, 완전히 사라지진 않아도... 가벼워져. 견딜 만해지고.
The Price of Ingenuity#044.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#045.src: Hoho! It does not especially, no. But I appreciate the sentiment. I am glad to have my family here with me.
The Price of Ingenuity#045.dst: 호호! 딱히 위로는 안 되네요. 그래도 마음은 고마워요. 가족이 곁에 있어서 다행이에요.
The Price of Ingenuity#045.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#046.src: But enough of that! I heard Quill was coming over? I had best freshen up before he arrives. I will join the rest of you later.
The Price of Ingenuity#046.dst: 자, 그 얘긴 그만! Quill이 온다고요? 그 전에 씻는 게 좋겠어요. 나중에 합류할게요.
The Price of Ingenuity#046.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#048.src: Hrrk..... f-f-five more minutes, m- s- Synd- Zzzzzzzzz.....
The Price of Ingenuity#048.dst: 크흡..... 오, 오, 오 분만 더, S- Synd- 쿨쿨쿨.....
The Price of Ingenuity#048.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#050.src: Okay, he's slept enough. What do you think, should I shoot him?
The Price of Ingenuity#050.dst: 좋아, 이만하면 많이 잤어. 어때, 한 방 쏠까?
The Price of Ingenuity#050.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#051.src: Pfft! Ha, kidding. It wouldn't work anyway, he's stubborn enough to just roll over and keep sleeping.
The Price of Ingenuity#051.dst: 풉! 하, 농담이야. 어차피 안 통해. 고집이 세서 그냥 돌아눕고 계속 잘걸.
The Price of Ingenuity#051.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#052.src: Hm, what can we try... oh, I know.
The Price of Ingenuity#052.dst: 흠, 뭘 해 볼까... 아, 알겠다.
The Price of Ingenuity#052.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#053.src: Oh, wow, these sure are some nice shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
The Price of Ingenuity#053.dst: 오, 와, 반짝반짝하고 희귀한 장신구들이 가득하네! 이런, Zeph가 깨어 있었다면 정말 좋아했을 텐데. 아쉽다!
The Price of Ingenuity#053.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#054.src: This is a fun one! It's a passion project, inspired by one of my favorite books, an intriguing story of a girl and her friends saving the world.
The Price of Ingenuity#054.dst: 이건 재밌는 거야! 내가 가장 좋아하는 책에서 영감을 받은 취미 작품인데, 한 소녀와 친구들이 세상을 구하는 흥미진진한 이야기야.

The Price of Ingenuity#055.src: Oh, wow, these sure are some nice and shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
The Price of Ingenuity#055.dst: 오, 와, 반짝반짝하고 희귀한 장신구들이 가득하네! 이런, Zeph가 깨어 있었다면 정말 좋아했을 텐데. 아쉽다!
The Price of Ingenuity#055.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#056.src: HUH! N-no, wait, I- I- I'm awake, where are- sh-sh-show me the t-trinkets, I want to see-
The Price of Ingenuity#056.dst: 헉! 아, 아니, 잠깐, 나, 나, 나 깼어, 어디- 보, 보, 보여 줘 자, 장신구, 보고 싶-
The Price of Ingenuity#056.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#059.src: There aren't an-any tr-trinkets, are there.
The Price of Ingenuity#059.dst: 장신구 같은 건 어, 없지, 그렇지.
The Price of Ingenuity#059.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#060.src: Nope! But I like the enthusiasm.
The Price of Ingenuity#060.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#061.src: Ugh... wh-why are you w-waking everyone up, anyway? I d-didn't think we had an-anything planned today..
The Price of Ingenuity#061.dst: 으... 그, 그런데 왜 다들 깨, 깨우는 거야? 오늘 아, 아무 계획 없던 것 같은데..
The Price of Ingenuity#061.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#062.src: O-oh! Uh... I- I- I- I slept... fine. G-g-good, even! Yeah!
The Price of Ingenuity#062.dst: 어, 어! 어... 나, 나, 나, 나 잘... 잤어. 자, 잘 잤어! 응!
The Price of Ingenuity#062.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#064.src: H-hey! What's that s-s-supposed to mean!?
The Price of Ingenuity#064.dst: 야, 야! 그게 무, 무, 무슨 뜻이야!?
The Price of Ingenuity#064.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#065.src: You got in bed super late! And you know how I know that? Because your snoring only started waking me up after that!
The Price of Ingenuity#065.dst: 너 엄청 늦게 잤잖아! 어떻게 아냐고? 그 뒤부터 네 코골이 때문에 내가 깼거든!
The Price of Ingenuity#065.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#066.src: I kept waking up thinking it was thundering outside, that's how loud it was!
The Price of Ingenuity#066.dst: 밖에 천둥 치는 줄 알고 계속 깼다니까. 그 정도로 시끄러웠어!
The Price of Ingenuity#066.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#067.src: Wh-what?! N-n-no, that's not- {u}, b-back me up here! I- I wasn't sn-snoring loudly, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#067.dst: 뭐, 뭐?! 아, 아, 아니야- {u}, 펴, 편 좀 들어 줘! 나, 나 코 크게 안 골았지?
The Price of Ingenuity#067.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#068.src: S-see! It couldn't have been th-that bad.
The Price of Ingenuity#068.dst: 보, 봐! 그렇게 시, 심하진 않았다고.
The Price of Ingenuity#068.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#069.src: Or maybe {u} needs to sleep lighter! Next thing you know, an enemy's gonna sneak up on you at night, and you're not gonna hear it because you're too used to Zeph's loud snoring!
The Price of Ingenuity#069.dst: 아니면 {u}이(가) 잠귀를 밝혀야지! 언젠가 밤에 적이 몰래 다가와도 Zeph 코골이에 익숙해서 못 들을걸!
The Price of Ingenuity#069.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#070.src: Oh my g-gods... the whole station m-must have heard me!
The Price of Ingenuity#070.dst: 마, 맙소사... 역 전체가 다 드, 들었겠다!
The Price of Ingenuity#070.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#071.src: It better have been just the station! Next thing you know, the crown's going to raid this hideout, and they would've only found it because your snoring echoes around {p} every night!
The Price of Ingenuity#071.dst: 역만이면 다행이지! 언젠가 왕실이 이 은신처를 급습할걸. 네 코골이가 밤마다 {p}에 울려 퍼져서 찾아낸 거고!
The Price of Ingenuity#071.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#073.src: Oh! W-wonder what it's about. Do you-
The Price of Ingenuity#073.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#074.src: Do you think h-he's mad about my mistake?
The Price of Ingenuity#074.dst: 혹시 내 실수 때문에 하, 화난 걸까?
The Price of Ingenuity#074.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#075.src: You heard him yourself, stupid. He wasn't mad! He thinks you did the right thing!
The Price of Ingenuity#075.dst: 네 귀로 들었잖아, 바보야. 화 안 났어! 네가 잘했다고 생각한다고!
The Price of Ingenuity#075.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#076.src: B-but... Still! Ugh. I'll have to go freshen up b-before he's here then!
The Price of Ingenuity#076.dst: 그, 그래도... 그래도! 으. 그럼 오기 전에 씻, 씻고 와야겠다!
The Price of Ingenuity#076.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#077.src: And that leaves one more. Hm...
The Price of Ingenuity#077.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#078.src: {u}, you should let me wake her.
The Price of Ingenuity#078.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#079.src: She's... kind of like Sui, but more intense? In the way she's, y'know. Military trained.
The Price of Ingenuity#079.dst: 걔는... Sui랑 비슷한데 더 격하다고 할까? 그러니까, 알잖아. 군사 훈련을 받았거든.
The Price of Ingenuity#079.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#080.src: So it's probably better if I do it since I know what I'm dealing with!
The Price of Ingenuity#080.dst: 뭘 상대하는지 아는 내가 하는 게 나을 거야!
The Price of Ingenuity#080.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#082.src: You know, you'd think she'd wake up at the crack of dawn with her military background... but nope.
The Price of Ingenuity#082.dst: 군인 출신이니 새벽같이 일어날 것 같잖아... 근데 아니더라고.
The Price of Ingenuity#082.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#086.src: I thought I'd be prepared for it, but nope...
The Price of Ingenuity#086.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#087.src: We thought you were asleep, Syndra! I was coming up to wake you!
The Price of Ingenuity#087.dst: 자는 줄 알았어, Syndra! 깨우러 올라온 거야!
The Price of Ingenuity#087.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#088.src: Well... I'm awake. Quill is stopping by, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#088.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#090.src: I've been awake for a while, Rex. I heard you talking about it downstairs!
The Price of Ingenuity#090.dst: 한참 전에 깼어, Rex. 아래층에서 하는 얘기 다 들었어!
The Price of Ingenuity#090.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#091.src: And here I thought I was a morning person...
The Price of Ingenuity#091.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#093.src: Ah, hello! Good morning to you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#093.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#095.src: Oh, dear. What is with all the formality this morning?
The Price of Ingenuity#095.dst: 이런. 오늘 아침엔 왜 이리 격식을 차리죠?
The Price of Ingenuity#095.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#096.src: Well, Yuman told us to be up and ready since you were coming-
The Price of Ingenuity#096.dst: 그게, Yuman이 당신이 오니까 일어나서 준비하라고-
The Price of Ingenuity#096.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#097.src: -so, naturally, the assumption was made that you had a mission for us-
The Price of Ingenuity#097.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#098.src: -o-o-or that w-we had done something wrong...
The Price of Ingenuity#098.dst: -아, 아, 아니면 우, 우리가 뭘 잘못했거나...
The Price of Ingenuity#098.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#101.src: Pahaha! Goodness, that was a lot all at once. Syndra, are they typically like this?
The Price of Ingenuity#101.dst: 파하하! 세상에, 한꺼번에 쏟아지네요. Syndra, 얘들은 늘 이런가요?
The Price of Ingenuity#101.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#102.src: They're not usually this snappy, no. But between meeting the brothers and experiencing the Roughworks, they're probably getting swept up in their emotions.
The Price of Ingenuity#102.dst: 평소엔 이렇게 날카롭진 않아요. 형제들을 만나고 Roughworks도 겪어서 감정에 휩쓸린 거겠죠.
The Price of Ingenuity#102.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#103.src: Ah... I understand, don't worry. But no, I'm not here to assign you all a mission, nor to scold you, or anything else of the sort.
The Price of Ingenuity#103.dst: 아... 이해해요, 걱정 마요. 하지만 아니에요, 임무를 주러 온 것도, 꾸짖으러 온 것도 아니에요.
The Price of Ingenuity#103.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#104.src: I simply wanted to offer you all a starting sum of tickets for the shops. I'd meant to give them yesterday, but in the chaos I forgot to.
The Price of Ingenuity#104.dst: 그저 상점에서 쓸 기본 티켓을 드리려고요. 어제 드리려 했는데 정신이 없어서 깜빡했어요.
The Price of Ingenuity#104.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#105.src: The ticket system is used to ration out food and other items to people that need it. You'll receive a weekly allowance of tickets to spend on whatever you'd like, in addition to this starting sum.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.dst: 티켓 제도로 식량과 물자를 필요한 사람에게 배급해요. 이 기본 지급분 말고도 매주 원하는 데 쓸 티켓이 나와요.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#106.src: Of course, basic amenities are free of charge if you're part of our community. Wouldn't want any of our members to sleep on the tracks, after all!
The Price of Ingenuity#106.dst: 물론 공동체 일원이면 기본 편의는 무료예요. 식구가 선로에서 자게 둘 순 없잖아요!
The Price of Ingenuity#106.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#107.src: So... I baked bread for, um, no reason?
The Price of Ingenuity#107.dst: 그럼... 나, 음, 괜히 빵 구운 거야?
The Price of Ingenuity#107.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#108.src: I fear so, haha! Do not worry, you will not be forced to do work here.
The Price of Ingenuity#108.dst: 그런 것 같네요, 하하! 걱정 마요, 여기서 억지로 일할 필요는 없어요.
The Price of Ingenuity#108.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#109.src: And, besides, if I wanted you to cook for us, I would have let you know well in advance.
The Price of Ingenuity#109.dst: 게다가 요리를 부탁할 거였으면 한참 전에 미리 말했을 거예요.
The Price of Ingenuity#109.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#110.src: I mean... I w-wouldn't mind some fr-fresh bread...
The Price of Ingenuity#110.dst: 그러니까... 가, 갓 구운 빵이면 나, 나는 좋은데...
The Price of Ingenuity#110.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#112.src: Ah, one more thing. I wanted to point you all towards the training yard- Zeph, I believe you have been there already?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.dst: 아, 하나 더요. 다들 훈련장에 가 보셨으면 해요- Zeph, 당신은 이미 가 봤죠?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#114.src: I believe the brothers should be there right now. If you're to be working with us, it would be best to get used to each other's fighting styles.
The Price of Ingenuity#114.dst: 형제들이 지금 거기 있을 거예요. 함께 일할 거라면 서로의 전투 방식에 익숙해지는 게 좋겠죠.
The Price of Ingenuity#114.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#115.src: Why don't you go join them there, while Syndra and I discuss further matters?
The Price of Ingenuity#115.dst: Syndra와 제가 다른 일을 논의하는 동안 거기 가서 합류하는 게 어때요?
The Price of Ingenuity#115.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#116.src: Find the brothers at the training yard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#117.src: ...do you really gotta head out there again?
The Price of Ingenuity#117.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#118.src: You know contracts are rare, man. I have to take what I can get.
The Price of Ingenuity#118.dst: 의뢰가 귀한 거 알잖아. 들어올 때 받아야지.
The Price of Ingenuity#118.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#119.src: Why's it always gotta be you and Yus heading out?! For once- for once, man, take care of yourself!
The Price of Ingenuity#119.dst: 왜 맨날 형이랑 Yus 형만 나가?! 한 번만- 한 번만이라도 몸 좀 챙겨!
The Price of Ingenuity#119.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#123.src: No, this can wait. Did Quill send you over?
The Price of Ingenuity#123.dst: 아니, 나중에 해도 돼. Quill이 보냈어?
The Price of Ingenuity#123.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#124.src: Indeed he did. He suggested we get to know each other's fighting styles!
The Price of Ingenuity#124.dst: 그래요. 서로의 전투 방식을 익혀 보라더군요!
The Price of Ingenuity#124.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#125.src: Not a bad idea. Yuman and I would be happy to show off what we can do, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#125.dst: 나쁘지 않네. Yuman이랑 내가 기꺼이 실력 보여 줄게, 그렇지?
The Price of Ingenuity#125.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#127.src: Well, Zeph, {u}, and I've already been through it! Some cool moves from you both! Man, getting to see a cursed one in action was awesome...
The Price of Ingenuity#127.dst: 뭐, Zeph랑 {u}, 나는 이미 해 봤어! 둘 다 멋지더라! 저주받은 자가 싸우는 걸 직접 보다니 끝내줬어...
The Price of Ingenuity#127.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#129.src: Yeah! Like, I'd hear all the stories, and think... man, having those kinds of powers sounds so cool. Sometimes I wished I could have em! Without, uh, being evil, of course.
The Price of Ingenuity#129.dst: 응! 옛날얘기 들으면서 생각했지... 그런 힘이 있으면 진짜 멋지겠다고. 가끔은 나도 갖고 싶었어! 물론, 어, 악당이 되는 건 빼고.
The Price of Ingenuity#129.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#130.src: You'd be even harder to deal with if you did, bro. But on that subject- Quill said something about you all practicing... what was the word he used... "magic?"
The Price of Ingenuity#130.dst: 너한테 그런 힘 있으면 더 감당 못 해. 근데 그 얘기 말인데- Quill이 너희가 뭘 연습한다던데... 뭐라더라... '마법'?
The Price of Ingenuity#130.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#131.src: What?! Ey, princess, why didn't you show anything off the other day?
The Price of Ingenuity#131.dst: 뭐?! 야, 공주님, 저번엔 왜 하나도 안 보여 줬어?
The Price of Ingenuity#131.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#133.src: Don't be insensitive, Yuman. It isn't something people just... pick up.
The Price of Ingenuity#133.dst: 눈치 좀 챙겨, Yuman. 아무나... 쉽게 익히는 게 아니야.
The Price of Ingenuity#133.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#134.src: From what little I've heard from Quill, it can take years of study to master a blessing... so I wouldn't be surprised if they couldn't even make a spark! Uh, no offense.
The Price of Ingenuity#134.dst: Quill한테 조금 들었는데, 축복 하나 익히는 데 몇 년이 걸리기도 한대... 불꽃 하나 못 튀겨도 놀랍지 않을 거야! 어, 악의는 없어.
The Price of Ingenuity#134.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#135.src: W- well... maybe we'll s- sur- surprise you!
The Price of Ingenuity#135.dst: 그, 그럼... 우리가 노, 놀, 놀라게 해 줄지도!
The Price of Ingenuity#135.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#136.src: Ha, think you're the only ones with hidden talents? I've got a trick or two up my sleeve too!
The Price of Ingenuity#136.dst: 하, 숨은 재주가 너희한테만 있는 줄 알아? 나도 소매 속에 비장의 수가 있다고!
The Price of Ingenuity#136.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#138.src: It's an expression, dumbass. Like you're one to talk. Why are you half-naked?
The Price of Ingenuity#138.dst: 관용구잖아, 멍청아. 누가 할 소리. 넌 왜 반쯤 벗고 다녀?
The Price of Ingenuity#138.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#139.src: To show off my abs? Obviously. Anyway, {u}, why don't you decide who goes first?
The Price of Ingenuity#139.dst: 복근 자랑하려고? 당연하지. 아무튼 {u}, 누가 먼저 할지 정해 볼래?
The Price of Ingenuity#139.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#141.src: Who, me? Sorry, but I'll sit this one out until you're all done.
The Price of Ingenuity#141.dst: 누구, 나? 미안하지만 너희 다 끝날 때까진 빠질게.
The Price of Ingenuity#141.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#142.src: Got to save the best for last, right? Heh.
The Price of Ingenuity#142.dst: 원래 최고는 마지막에 나오는 법이잖아? 헤.
The Price of Ingenuity#142.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#143.src: I'll have to add arrows until my bowstring runs out of space next time...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.dst: 다음엔 시위에 자리 없을 때까지 화살을 더 걸어야겠어...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#144.src: I'll h-have to come back here a-again tonight!
The Price of Ingenuity#144.dst: 오, 오늘 밤에 여기 또 와야겠다!
The Price of Ingenuity#144.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#145.src: It's like there's ripples gently spreading within me...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.dst: 내 안에서 물결이 잔잔하게 퍼지는 것 같아...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#146.src: To see my powers growing this clearly...
The Price of Ingenuity#146.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#148.src: Dang, I think I overloaded it. I'll have to put it through a charge cycle...
The Price of Ingenuity#148.dst: 젠장, 과부하 걸린 것 같네. 충전 한 번 돌려야겠어...
The Price of Ingenuity#148.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#150.src: So. Magic, curses, blessings... whatever you want to call it, it hasn't worked for me. It just doesn't... click.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.dst: 그래서. 마법, 저주, 축복... 뭐라 부르든 난 안 되더라. 그냥... 감이 안 와.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#151.src: Ah, not to worry, Rex! Even without it, none in the province could match your accuracy with a bow.
The Price of Ingenuity#151.dst: 아, 걱정 말아요, Rex! 그게 없어도 활 솜씨로 이 지방에서 당신을 따를 자는 없어요.
The Price of Ingenuity#151.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#152.src: Y- yeah! And if you d- did get magic, it'd j- jus- just be unfair for the rest of us!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.dst: 그, 그래! 너까지 마, 마법을 쓰면 우리한텐 너, 너, 너무 불공평하지!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#153.src: Yeah, yeah, sure. Either way, I've been practicing a new technique... let's see if I can pull it off.
The Price of Ingenuity#153.dst: 그래, 그래. 아무튼 새 기술을 연습해 왔거든... 성공하나 보자.
The Price of Ingenuity#153.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#155.src: Yep! I just place every arrow on the string at once, which lets me shoot at a much larger area!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.dst: 응! 화살을 한꺼번에 전부 시위에 걸어서 훨씬 넓은 범위를 쏘는 거야!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#156.src: But... how'd you manage to hit each arrow right on target?! That's... insane!
The Price of Ingenuity#156.dst: 근데... 화살을 어떻게 전부 정확히 맞혀?! 말도... 안 돼!
The Price of Ingenuity#156.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#157.src: Ha. Go on, keep praising my skill. That was actually the first time I tried that many arrows at once... glad it worked out!
The Price of Ingenuity#157.dst: 하. 계속 해, 내 실력 더 칭찬해. 사실 그렇게 많이 한꺼번에 쏜 건 처음이야... 성공해서 다행이다!
The Price of Ingenuity#157.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#158.src: The... first... You said you'd practiced it, man! What do you mean that was the first time?!
The Price of Ingenuity#158.dst: 처... 음... 연습했다며! 처음이라니 무슨 소리야?!
The Price of Ingenuity#158.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#159.src: Yeah? I practiced theoretically. In my head. Keep up, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#159.dst: 응? 이론으로 연습했지. 머릿속으로. 따라와, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#159.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#161.src: Couldn't even make a spark, eh?
The Price of Ingenuity#161.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#162.src: Alright, alright! I've been proven wrong.
The Price of Ingenuity#162.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#164.src: So... I w-want to first say that I've been c-coming here every night.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.dst: 그러니까... 먼저 말하자면 나 매일 밤 여, 여기 왔었어.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#165.src: I was e-embarrassed that I just didn't g-get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#165.dst: 나만 도, 도무지 못 익혀서 창피했거든.
The Price of Ingenuity#165.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#166.src: I mean, j-just look at how fast your m-magic developed, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.dst: 그러니까, 네 마, 마법이 얼마나 빨리 늘었는지 봐, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#167.src: And you, S-sui! You are a natural, a-after all.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.dst: 그리고 너, S-Sui! 넌 역시 타, 타고났잖아.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#168.src: I still don't know any form of magic. Why feel so embarassed?
The Price of Ingenuity#168.dst: 난 아직 마법 하나도 못 써. 뭘 그렇게 창피해해?
The Price of Ingenuity#168.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#169.src: Rex, you don't even n-need magic to be a valuable asset! You're the best archer in the w-world!
The Price of Ingenuity#169.dst: Rex, 넌 마법 없이도 소중한 전력이잖아! 세, 세상 최고의 궁수라고!
The Price of Ingenuity#169.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#170.src: I don't h-have that skill! My blade skills a-aren't good enough! You've h-had to save me time and time a-again.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.dst: 난 그런 재주가 어, 없어! 검술도 부, 부족하고! 네가 날 몇 번이나 구, 구해 줬잖아.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#171.src: And {u}, I felt like I had l-let you down after all the k-knowledge you had given me.
The Price of Ingenuity#171.dst: 그리고 {u}, 그렇게 많이 가르쳐 줬는데 널 실, 실망시킨 것 같았어.
The Price of Ingenuity#171.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#172.src: I may not have talked to you a lot, Zeph. But from what I know of the science behind magic, you don't have to blame yourself for not getting it.
The Price of Ingenuity#172.dst: Zeph, 너랑 얘기는 많이 못 해 봤지. 그래도 마법 뒤의 과학을 아는 입장에서, 못 익힌다고 자책할 필요 없어.
The Price of Ingenuity#172.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#173.src: A lot of people study magic their whole lives. I'm sure you'll get there eventually.
The Price of Ingenuity#173.dst: 평생 마법을 연구하는 사람도 많아. 너도 언젠간 해낼 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#173.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#174.src: Thank y-you, Yusanu. However, I think I f-finally figured it out...
The Price of Ingenuity#174.dst: 고, 고마워, Yusanu. 그런데 드, 드디어 알아낸 것 같아...
The Price of Ingenuity#174.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#176.src: I think I'm finally g-getting this magic thing somewhat down!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.dst: 이제야 마법이 조, 조금 손에 익는 것 같아!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#177.src: I will n-not stop practicing! N-not until I can m-m-match you all!
The Price of Ingenuity#177.dst: 연습 아, 안 멈출 거야! 너희를 따, 따, 따라잡을 때까진!
The Price of Ingenuity#177.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#179.src: Come on, man! Show us what you've got!
The Price of Ingenuity#179.dst: 에이, 해 봐! 실력 좀 보여 줘!
The Price of Ingenuity#179.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#180.src: ...okay. I've tried to, um, practice a bit, now that I'm... yeah.
The Price of Ingenuity#180.dst: ...알았어. 음, 조금 연습해 봤어, 이제 내가... 그러니까.
The Price of Ingenuity#180.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#181.src: I haven't fully developed it, but, I have this new skill...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.dst: 아직 완성은 못 했지만, 새 기술이 있어...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#182.src: Okay! I'm going to try it!
The Price of Ingenuity#182.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#183.src: W- woah! It's like you ma- made that out of n- n- nothing!
The Price of Ingenuity#183.dst: 우, 우와! 무, 무, 무에서 만들어 낸 것 같아!
The Price of Ingenuity#183.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#184.src: ...ugh! It takes so much concentration... even a word makes me fail...
The Price of Ingenuity#184.dst: ...으! 집중력이 엄청 필요해... 말 한마디에도 실패해...
The Price of Ingenuity#184.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#185.src: Also. It's not, um, out of nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#185.dst: 그리고. 음, 무에서 만든 거 아니야.
The Price of Ingenuity#185.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#186.src: It's like... there's an ocean of swirling energy, all around me. If I can get a bit, in, like... a bucket, I can use it. But... I don't know how to get it without, um, falling into it and getting overwhelmed.
The Price of Ingenuity#186.dst: 그러니까... 내 주위에 소용돌이치는 에너지의 바다가 있어. 조금을, 음... 양동이에 떠 담으면 쓸 수 있어. 근데... 음, 그 속에 빠져서 휩쓸리지 않고 뜨는 법을 모르겠어.
The Price of Ingenuity#186.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#188.src: Uh... n- not- not really, but-
The Price of Ingenuity#188.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#193.src: I... I'm fine. No, even... more than that...
The Price of Ingenuity#193.dst: 나... 난 괜찮아. 아니, 오히려... 그 이상이야...
The Price of Ingenuity#193.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#194.src: It's like... I finally felt this power's ebb and flow, not just... it pouring out, I...
The Price of Ingenuity#194.dst: 그러니까... 드디어 이 힘의 밀물과 썰물을 느꼈어, 그냥... 쏟아지는 게 아니라, 난...
The Price of Ingenuity#194.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#195.src: ...ah! Is everyone fine? You... you all seem fine. Okay...
The Price of Ingenuity#195.dst: ...아! 다들 괜찮아? 다... 다들 괜찮아 보이네. 휴...
The Price of Ingenuity#195.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#196.src: I think... I think that's all from me.
The Price of Ingenuity#196.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#197.src: Very well! This is as good an opportunity as any to show off my progress!
The Price of Ingenuity#197.dst: 좋아요! 제 성장을 보여 줄 절호의 기회로군요!
The Price of Ingenuity#197.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#198.src: Although I am proficient in combat with my hammer, that is... standard. So, allow me to show my magic instead, as that is what I have been training!
The Price of Ingenuity#198.dst: 망치 전투에는 능숙하지만, 그건... 평범하지요. 그러니 대신 마법을 보여 드리죠. 그걸 수련해 왔거든요!
The Price of Ingenuity#198.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#199.src: ...oh, dear. I did not expect it to have become so powerful! It seems I must still master control over it...
The Price of Ingenuity#199.dst: ...이런. 이렇게 강해졌을 줄은 몰랐어요! 아직 제어하는 법을 익혀야겠군요...
The Price of Ingenuity#199.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#200.src: I apologize for the damage I have caused. If you would ask for compensation, I would gladly provide it.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.dst: 부순 것들은 사과드려요. 배상을 원하시면 기꺼이 해 드리지요.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#201.src: Eh, don't worry about it. It's just a training room. Besides, all this junk in here doesn't even work anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.dst: 에, 신경 쓰지 마. 그냥 훈련실인데. 게다가 여기 고물들은 원래 작동도 안 해.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#203.src: Yo, that was badass, man! Your curse is awesome.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.dst: 와, 끝내준다! 네 저주 진짜 멋지다.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#204.src: Is it! I suppose it is, haha! I am glad to have had the oppurtunity to learn to use it.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.dst: 그런가요! 그런 것 같네요, 하하! 쓰는 법을 배울 기회가 있어서 다행이에요.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#205.src: That is all, then. Who will go next?
The Price of Ingenuity#205.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#206.src: Lemme show you just what I can really do, man.
The Price of Ingenuity#206.dst: 내 진짜 실력이 뭔지 보여 주지.
The Price of Ingenuity#206.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#207.src: Watch and learn, princess. Not every day you get to see me shred.
The Price of Ingenuity#207.dst: 잘 보고 배워, 공주님. 내 연주는 매일 볼 수 있는 게 아니라고.
The Price of Ingenuity#207.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#209.src: Yuman But wait! That's not all!
The Price of Ingenuity#209.dst: Yuman 하지만 잠깐! 이게 끝이 아니야!
The Price of Ingenuity#209.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#210.src: My Sonic Boomer can help out with defense too! I'm no one trick pony - I can cover every genre of combat!
The Price of Ingenuity#210.dst: Sonic Boomer는 방어에도 쓸 수 있어! 한 곡만 하는 놈 아니야. 전투 장르는 전부 소화한다고!
The Price of Ingenuity#210.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#211.src: And bam! That's it from me and Sonic Boomer for today.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.dst: 그리고 쾅! 오늘 나랑 Sonic Boomer는 여기까지야.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#214.src: I'll say, I'm not as... direct... as Yuman. But I can hold my own in a fight.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.dst: 말해 두자면 난 Yuman만큼... 직설적이진 않아. 그래도 싸움에서 밀리진 않아.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#216.src: I mean... yeah? Yusanu made this thing for me, and he calls it the Electric Blaster.
The Price of Ingenuity#216.dst: 그러니까... 응? Yusanu가 만들어 줬는데, Electric Blaster라고 부르더라.
The Price of Ingenuity#216.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#217.src: It's also able to fire a much larger blast with way more power, but that does make it less... precise.
The Price of Ingenuity#217.dst: 훨씬 강력한 광역 폭발도 쏠 수 있는데, 그러면 좀... 덜 정확해져.
The Price of Ingenuity#217.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#218.src: That's all from me. Next one!
The Price of Ingenuity#218.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#219.src: Alrighty! Let's see... where to start...
The Price of Ingenuity#219.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#220.src: Oh, you have gotta be... again?! Really?! Ugh!
The Price of Ingenuity#220.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#221.src: Yulie, Yuman, can you check the tunnels for any intruders?
The Price of Ingenuity#221.dst: Yulie 형, Yuman, 터널에 침입자 있나 확인해 줄래?
The Price of Ingenuity#221.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#222.src: If you need us to. Keep us updated, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.dst: 필요하다면. 상황 계속 알려 줄 거지?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#223.src: Sure. Get the others to help you, I gotta run and check on things!
The Price of Ingenuity#223.dst: 그래. 다른 사람들한테 도와 달라고 해. 난 가서 확인해 봐야 해!
The Price of Ingenuity#223.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#224.src: Of course we can help, just tell us what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#224.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#225.src: {u} and I actually have some important tasks Syndra needed done!! Will you be okay without us?
The Price of Ingenuity#225.dst: 사실 {u}이랑 나는 Syndra가 맡긴 중요한 일이 있어!! 우리 없어도 괜찮지?
The Price of Ingenuity#225.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#226.src: We will. It shouldn't be too hard for us, anyway- just routine check ups.
The Price of Ingenuity#226.dst: 괜찮아. 어차피 어렵지 않을 거야- 그냥 정기 점검이야.
The Price of Ingenuity#226.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#227.src: Yep, yep! Alright guys, follow papa!
The Price of Ingenuity#227.dst: 그래, 그래! 자, 다들 아빠 따라와!
The Price of Ingenuity#227.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#228.src: Wh- what? Ugh... put some c- cl- clothes on, a- at- at least.
The Price of Ingenuity#228.dst: 뭐, 뭐? 으... 옷 좀 이, 입, 입어, 제, 제발.
The Price of Ingenuity#228.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#232.src: I needed a way to get everyone else out of here so we could talk!
The Price of Ingenuity#232.dst: 얘기하려면 다른 사람들을 여기서 내보내야 했어!
The Price of Ingenuity#232.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#233.src: Yeah, obviously! It was the best excuse I could come up with in the moment.
The Price of Ingenuity#233.dst: 응, 당연하지! 그 순간 떠올린 최선의 핑계였어.
The Price of Ingenuity#233.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#234.src: So, look. Yusanu's been really hard to get a read of! He's barely ever around- I'm honestly surprised he even showed up today!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.dst: 그러니까, 봐. Yusanu는 속을 도통 모르겠어! 거의 안 보이잖아- 솔직히 오늘 나타난 것도 놀라워!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#235.src: But anyway, when you and Zeph headed out with Yuman during the last alarm, I wanted to check in with Yusanu and see what he was up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#235.dst: 아무튼, 지난번 경보 때 너랑 Zeph가 Yuman이랑 나갔잖아. 그때 Yusanu가 뭐 하나 보러 갔었어.
The Price of Ingenuity#235.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#236.src: But guess what? He was gone! Walked into his workshop and never walked out. Isn't that weird?
The Price of Ingenuity#236.dst: 근데 어떻게 됐게? 사라졌어! 작업장에 들어가서 안 나왔어. 이상하지 않아?
The Price of Ingenuity#236.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#237.src: I don't know what it means, and I don't know if he's a risk to us or not. But what I do know is that he's suspicious!
The Price of Ingenuity#237.dst: 무슨 뜻인지, 우리한테 위험한지도 모르겠어. 하지만 확실한 건 수상하다는 거야!
The Price of Ingenuity#237.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#238.src: Because they'd all probably tell me not to do anything impulsive right now. Which isn't even true, I've thought this plan out extensively!
The Price of Ingenuity#238.dst: 다들 지금 충동적으로 굴지 말라고 할 테니까. 사실도 아닌데. 이 계획은 철저히 생각했다고!
The Price of Ingenuity#238.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#239.src: Come on, meet me outside his workshop! I just want to look. If it's nothing, then it's nothing! But I don't think it's nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#239.dst: 자, 작업장 밖에서 만나! 그냥 보기만 할 거야. 아무것도 없으면 그만이고! 근데 뭔가 있을 것 같아.
The Price of Ingenuity#239.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#241.src: I'll meet up with you at the workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#241.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#244.src: See? I told you! He's just... gone.
The Price of Ingenuity#244.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#245.src: Not even a trace... Seems like I wasn't distrustful for nothing. But how?
The Price of Ingenuity#245.dst: 흔적 하나 없어... 괜히 의심한 건 아니었네. 근데 어떻게?
The Price of Ingenuity#245.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#246.src: He has to have gone somewhere! He couldn't have just... vanished.
The Price of Ingenuity#246.dst: 어딘가로 간 게 틀림없어! 그냥... 증발했을 리 없어.
The Price of Ingenuity#246.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#247.src: There has to be something else going on here! Do you see why I suspect him now?
The Price of Ingenuity#247.dst: 분명 다른 뭔가가 있어! 이제 내가 왜 의심하는지 알겠지?
The Price of Ingenuity#247.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#248.src: Let's snoop around a bit and make sure he's not posing a threat to us.
The Price of Ingenuity#248.dst: 좀 뒤져 보자. 우리한테 위협이 아닌지 확인해야 해.
The Price of Ingenuity#248.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#249.src: I'm glad you feel that way. Makes me feel less... horrible... about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#249.dst: 그렇게 생각해 줘서 다행이다. 덜... 끔찍한 기분이야.
The Price of Ingenuity#249.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#250.src: I guess we can be horrible people together, then.
The Price of Ingenuity#250.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#251.src: I get it, trust me. They've taken us in and given us a place to stay, and now...
The Price of Ingenuity#251.dst: 알아, 믿어. 우릴 받아 주고 지낼 곳도 줬는데, 이제...
The Price of Ingenuity#251.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#252.src: If we're wrong, if I'm wrong, then we both might get thrown out.
The Price of Ingenuity#252.dst: 우리가 틀렸으면, 내가 틀렸으면, 둘 다 쫓겨날지도 몰라.
The Price of Ingenuity#252.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#253.src: The blame will land squarely on us both. I really hope that even if we are kicked out, the rest can still stay here...
The Price of Ingenuity#253.dst: 책임은 고스란히 우리 둘한테 올 거야. 우리가 쫓겨나도 나머지는 여기 남을 수 있으면 좋겠어...
The Price of Ingenuity#253.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#254.src: ...no time to dwell on that. He must have left the workshop through an exit somewhere. Let's look around and see what we can find.
The Price of Ingenuity#254.dst: ...그런 생각할 시간 없어. 작업장 어딘가의 출구로 나간 게 분명해. 둘러보면서 뭐가 있나 찾아보자.
The Price of Ingenuity#254.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#255.src: Try and find Yusanu in his workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#256.src: Aha! And you thought I was just being paranoid.
The Price of Ingenuity#256.dst: 아하! 그런데도 내가 괜한 의심한다고 생각했지.
The Price of Ingenuity#256.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#257.src: But you were thinking it, I could tell!
The Price of Ingenuity#257.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#258.src: Okay, fine, maybe a little. But I was right to be!
The Price of Ingenuity#258.dst: 그래, 알았어, 조금은 그랬을지도. 그래도 의심한 게 맞았잖아!
The Price of Ingenuity#258.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#259.src: That's confirmation. Though, not like we needed it...
The Price of Ingenuity#259.dst: 이걸로 확실해졌네. 뭐, 확인할 필요도 없었지만...
The Price of Ingenuity#259.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#262.src: Yusanu's really puulling out all the stops to make sure nobody follows him!
The Price of Ingenuity#262.dst: Yusanu가 아무도 못 따라오게 온갖 수를 다 썼네!
The Price of Ingenuity#262.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#263.src: Too bad we're persistent, though. There's got to be some way to open it, we just need to find it!
The Price of Ingenuity#263.dst: 안됐지만 우린 끈질기거든. 여는 방법이 분명 있어. 찾기만 하면 돼!
The Price of Ingenuity#263.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#264.src: Whatever you did seems to have worked, the door's open!
The Price of Ingenuity#264.dst: 뭘 했든 통했나 봐, 문이 열렸어!
The Price of Ingenuity#264.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#266.src: Dead end? No, I see something on the other side...
The Price of Ingenuity#266.dst: 막다른 길? 아니, 건너편에 뭐가 보여...
The Price of Ingenuity#266.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#267.src: How do we get across? I guess you could try to use your magic... but I don't want you to put yourself at risk just cause I dragged you along for this.
The Price of Ingenuity#267.dst: 어떻게 건너지? 네 마법을 써 볼 수도 있겠지만... 내가 끌고 왔다고 네가 위험을 무릅쓰는 건 싫어.
The Price of Ingenuity#267.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#270.src: Oh! Yusanu has to have taken this way, there aren't any other options. So, there's a trick to it...
The Price of Ingenuity#270.dst: 아! Yusanu도 분명 이 길로 갔어, 다른 길은 없어. 그러니까 뭔가 요령이 있어...
The Price of Ingenuity#270.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#271.src: Look, over there! Do you see the button on the other side? I bet he uses it to close off this path whenever he takes it.
The Price of Ingenuity#271.dst: 봐, 저기! 건너편에 버튼 보여? 이 길을 지날 때마다 저걸로 막아 두는 게 분명해.
The Price of Ingenuity#271.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#272.src: It's a good thing you have the best sharpshooter in all of Fruma on your side! A shot like that is nothing to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#272.dst: Fruma 최고의 명사수가 네 편이라 다행이지! 저 정도는 식은 죽 먹기야.
The Price of Ingenuity#272.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#273.src: Just a moment... need to line it up... just right...
The Price of Ingenuity#273.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#274.src: Got it! Oh, that's more precarious than I expected. Be careful!
The Price of Ingenuity#274.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#276.src: ...okay, why are we right outside the Sovereign's mansion?!
The Price of Ingenuity#276.dst: ...좋아, 근데 왜 군주 저택 바로 앞이야?!
The Price of Ingenuity#276.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#277.src: This place is so heavily guarded, and he just has a secret tunnel directly to the front door?!
The Price of Ingenuity#277.dst: 경비가 이렇게 삼엄한데 정문으로 바로 통하는 비밀 터널이 있다고?!
The Price of Ingenuity#277.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#279.src: We can't just leave it here, obviously, but we're definitely not getting through the front door...
The Price of Ingenuity#279.dst: 당연히 이대로 둘 순 없지만, 정문으로는 절대 못 들어가...
The Price of Ingenuity#279.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#280.src: Look, up there. The arch connects to the main structure, and probably has a way inside.
The Price of Ingenuity#280.dst: 봐, 저 위. 아치가 본관이랑 이어져 있어. 안으로 들어갈 길이 있을 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#280.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#281.src: Maybe we can get up by climbing this building over here!
The Price of Ingenuity#281.dst: 여기 이 건물을 타고 올라가면 되겠다!
The Price of Ingenuity#281.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#282.src: Travel up the nearby building at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter Soosu's mansion.
The Price of Ingenuity#282.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 근처 건물을 타고 올라가 Soosu의 저택에 들어가세요.

The Price of Ingenuity#283.src: Sneak through Soosu's mansion looking for Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#283.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 Soosu의 저택에 몰래 들어가 Yusanu를 찾으세요.

The Price of Ingenuity#284.src: ... Hey, stay on your guard. We don't want to get caught in here.
The Price of Ingenuity#284.dst: ... 야, 경계 늦추지 마. 여기서 잡히면 안 돼.
The Price of Ingenuity#284.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#285.src: Though... it's kind of quiet in here. Weird.
The Price of Ingenuity#285.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#286.src: Okay. Okay okay. That's a lot of buttons.
The Price of Ingenuity#286.dst: 좋아. 좋아 좋아. 버튼 진짜 많네.
The Price of Ingenuity#286.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#287.src: So these two say up and down... over here it looks like a list...? Office, Workshop, Quarters, Workshop {~}, Roof Workshop... And why is there a lever? It's not even labeled.
The Price of Ingenuity#287.dst: 이 두 개는 위, 아래고... 여기는 목록 같은데...? 사무실, 작업장, 숙소, 작업장 {~}, 옥상 작업장... 레버는 왜 있어? 이름표도 없네.
The Price of Ingenuity#287.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#288.src: Ugh, I can never figure out Roughworks machines. Always overly complicated...
The Price of Ingenuity#288.dst: 으, Roughworks 기계는 도통 모르겠어. 늘 쓸데없이 복잡해...
The Price of Ingenuity#288.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#289.src: Well, what about you? Any thoughts?
The Price of Ingenuity#289.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#290.src: Okay. Sure! As good a suggestion as any.
The Price of Ingenuity#290.dst: 좋아. 그래! 다른 거랑 별 차이 없겠지.
The Price of Ingenuity#290.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#291.src: ...so, which one of these is up?
The Price of Ingenuity#291.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#292.src: Okay. Thanks for the input. I'm... not going to do that! That sounds like an awful idea- has Zeph been rubbing off on you?
The Price of Ingenuity#292.dst: 좋아. 의견 고마워. 난... 그렇게 안 할 거야! 최악의 생각 같은데- 너 Zeph 물들었어?
The Price of Ingenuity#292.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#293.src: And I thought one of him was bad enough...
The Price of Ingenuity#293.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#294.src: Oh, whatever! Let's just try something.
The Price of Ingenuity#294.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#298.src: That was... I don't want to talk about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#298.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#299.src: Wait! {u}, quietly, come look at this.
The Price of Ingenuity#299.dst: 잠깐! {u}, 조용히 와서 이것 좀 봐.
The Price of Ingenuity#299.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#300.src: Shoot, they're coming this way! Follow me!
The Price of Ingenuity#300.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#302.src: Approximately {~} of the input fuel energy is lost as heat. This results in a poor overall performance.
The Price of Ingenuity#302.dst: 투입된 연료 에너지의 약 {~}이(가) 열로 손실된다. 그 결과 전체 성능이 떨어진다.

The Price of Ingenuity#307.src: N-O-O-O!!! Mother w-o-o-o-ould know what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#307.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#309.src: Those "guards" don't seem very normal, do they? Isn't this supposed to be the Sovereign's mansion?
The Price of Ingenuity#309.dst: 저 '경비들' 좀 이상하지 않아? 여기 군주 저택 맞아?
The Price of Ingenuity#309.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#310.src: They didn't even see us... oh, whatever. Let's keep moving.
The Price of Ingenuity#310.dst: 우릴 보지도 못했네... 아, 됐어. 계속 가자.
The Price of Ingenuity#310.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#312.src: Why did you call me here again so soon? I was just here yesterday.
The Price of Ingenuity#312.dst: 왜 또 이렇게 빨리 불렀어요? 어제도 왔잖아요.
The Price of Ingenuity#312.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#313.src: Oh, don't play dumb! Dead soldiers! Killed on the job! Sound familiar??
The Price of Ingenuity#313.dst: 어머, 시치미 떼지 마! 죽은 병사들! 근무 중에 죽었지! 뭐 생각나??
The Price of Ingenuity#313.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#315.src: Well, it better! Again - dead soldiers!! We had an agreement, Yus, and you've clearly gone and broken it!
The Price of Ingenuity#315.dst: 생각나야지! 다시 말할게 - 병사가 죽었어!! 우리 약속했잖아, Yus. 넌 그걸 깨 버렸고!
The Price of Ingenuity#315.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#316.src: I- I know. And I'm sorry that it happened. But- it happened while I was here, working! What do you expect me to have done about it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#316.dst: 아- 알아요. 그 일은 죄송해요. 하지만- 전 여기서 일하던 중이었다고요! 제가 뭘 할 수 있었겠어요?!
The Price of Ingenuity#316.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#317.src: Hmph! You're smart, aren't you? Smart enough to be able to grasp the fundamentals of conductivity and electrical currents! You could have found a way.
The Price of Ingenuity#317.dst: 흥! 넌 똑똑하잖아? 전도성이랑 전류의 원리를 이해할 만큼 똑똑하지! 방법을 찾을 수 있었을 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#317.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#318.src: It's such a shame... you were one of my favorites, Yus. And now you've really let me down.
The Price of Ingenuity#318.dst: 정말 아쉽다... 넌 내가 제일 아끼던 애 중 하나였어, Yus. 근데 이번엔 진짜 실망이야.
The Price of Ingenuity#318.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#319.src: ...I know. I- I'll find a way to fix it. Tell me what to do, and- and I can. Whatever I need to- so I can keep them safe- I'll, I'll do it.
The Price of Ingenuity#319.dst: ...알아요. 제- 제가 수습할게요. 뭘 하면 되는지 말해 주면- 할 수 있어요. 그들을 지킬 수 있다면- 뭐든, 뭐든 할게요.
The Price of Ingenuity#319.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#320.src: Oh, Yus, you're so silly. There's nothing you can do to fix this now. The damage is done, and nobody around here will shut! Up! About it!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#320.dst: 어머, Yus, 바보같이. 이제 와서 수습할 방법은 없어. 일은 벌어졌고, 여기 사람들은 입을! 다물! 생각을 안 해!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#320.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#321.src: I let you live in that abandoned trainyard because I thought you'd be quiet. But this isn't quiet! I can't focus now that everyone is-
The Price of Ingenuity#321.dst: 조용히 지낼 줄 알고 그 버려진 차량기지에 살게 해 줬던 거야. 근데 이건 조용한 게 아니잖아! 다들 떠들어서 집중을 못 하-
The Price of Ingenuity#321.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#323.src: A GHO–O–O–OST! SPARKLES HEARD A GHO–O–O–O–OST! WHAT DO WE–E–E–E DO???
The Price of Ingenuity#323.dst: 유–우–우–령! SPARKLES가 유–우–우–우–령 소리를 들었어! 어떻게 해–애–애–애???
The Price of Ingenuity#323.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#324.src: Ugh! Not now!! Can't you see mommy's busy?!
The Price of Ingenuity#324.dst: 으! 지금은 안 돼!! 엄마 바쁜 거 안 보여?!
The Price of Ingenuity#324.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#326.src: ...They'll be fine. I'll just bring them back later!
The Price of Ingenuity#326.dst: ...괜찮을 거야. 나중에 다시 살려 놓으면 돼!
The Price of Ingenuity#326.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#327.src: You know, they've been getting better and better at replicating human behavior! My latest constructs were at an estimated {~} accuracy-
The Price of Ingenuity#327.dst: 있잖아, 쟤들 인간 행동 흉내가 점점 늘고 있어! 최신 구조체는 정확도가 대략 {~}였다고-
The Price of Ingenuity#327.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#329.src: Right! Here's what you can do for me, Yus. This isn't going to go away. I need someone to pin this on, so they'll all shut up and move on from it!
The Price of Ingenuity#329.dst: 맞다! 네가 해 줄 일은 이거야, Yus. 이 일은 그냥 안 묻혀. 누군가한테 뒤집어씌워야 다들 입 다물고 넘어가지!
The Price of Ingenuity#329.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#330.src: Especially that loudmouth from the north! Would it kill him to leave me alone and stop meddling in my business??
The Price of Ingenuity#330.dst: 특히 북쪽의 그 떠버리! 날 좀 내버려 두고 내 일에 참견 좀 안 하면 어디 덧나??
The Price of Ingenuity#330.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#332.src: Don't answer that. Look, this is the only way. You need to hand over whoever is responsible for this whole thing. That's the only way we can keep our peace and keep being friends.
The Price of Ingenuity#332.dst: 대답하지 마. 봐, 이 방법밖에 없어. 이 일 전체의 책임자를 넘겨. 그래야 평화도 지키고 계속 친구로 지낼 수 있어.
The Price of Ingenuity#332.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#333.src: Wh- you can't be serious! I can't do that, Soosu! You- you really expect me to give up one of my friends or family?!
The Price of Ingenuity#333.dst: 뭐- 진심이에요?! 그건 못 해요, Soosu! 제- 제 친구나 가족을 넘기라고요?!
The Price of Ingenuity#333.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#334.src: No, Yus, what I expected from you was to keep your "friends and family" quiet! But we're past that point now. Something needs to happen.
The Price of Ingenuity#334.dst: 아니, Yus, 내가 바란 건 네 '친구와 가족'을 조용히 시키는 거였어! 근데 이젠 늦었어. 뭔가 일어나야 해.
The Price of Ingenuity#334.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#335.src: I-... I understand. I need to think. I'll... I'll let you know soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#335.dst: 저-... 알겠어요. 생각할 시간이 필요해요. 곧... 곧 알려 드릴게요.
The Price of Ingenuity#335.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#336.src: What is he doing?! Sneaking around, meeting with the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#336.dst: 저 녀석 뭐 하는 거야?! 몰래 다니면서 군주를 만나?!
The Price of Ingenuity#336.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#337.src: We need to cut him off. I'm not letting him get away with this. Follow me, quickly!
The Price of Ingenuity#337.dst: 길을 막아야 해. 이대로 넘어가게 둘 순 없어. 따라와, 빨리!
The Price of Ingenuity#337.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#338.src: Come on! Let's see if we can cut him off before he enters the tunnel!
The Price of Ingenuity#338.dst: 어서! 터널에 들어가기 전에 가로막을 수 있나 보자!
The Price of Ingenuity#338.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#340.src: Okay. This is as good a place as any to hide out and wait...
The Price of Ingenuity#340.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#341.src: I can't believe this! I can't believe him! How long has he been doing this?
The Price of Ingenuity#341.dst: 믿을 수가 없어! 저 녀석 믿을 수가 없어! 대체 언제부터 이랬던 거야?
The Price of Ingenuity#341.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#342.src: I... uh, I'll see you guys later, I... guess.
The Price of Ingenuity#342.dst: 나... 어, 나중에 보자, 난... 아마도.
The Price of Ingenuity#342.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#346.src: Not a word, Yusanu. You are in no position to be asking questions!
The Price of Ingenuity#346.dst: 한마디도 하지 마, Yusanu. 지금 질문할 처지가 아니잖아!
The Price of Ingenuity#346.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#347.src: Secretly meeting with the Sovereign? Really? Are you insane?!
The Price of Ingenuity#347.dst: 몰래 군주를 만나? 진짜? 너 미쳤어?!
The Price of Ingenuity#347.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#348.src: You- you... followed me... oh, no... no no no, no... you weren't seen, were you? You're going to ruin ev-
The Price of Ingenuity#348.dst: 너- 너희... 날 미행했어... 아, 안 돼... 안 돼 안 돼, 안 돼... 들키진 않았지? 너희 때문에 다 망-
The Price of Ingenuity#348.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#349.src: We're going to ruin everything?! And not you, the guy always sneaking off to meet the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#349.dst: 우리 때문에 다 망친다고?! 맨날 몰래 군주 만나러 가는 네가 아니고?!
The Price of Ingenuity#349.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#350.src: You don't understand! The only reason we're safe down there is BECAUSE I struck a deal with her!!
The Price of Ingenuity#350.dst: 모르면서 그래! 우리가 저 아래서 안전한 건 '내가' 그 여자랑 거래를 했기 때문이야!!
The Price of Ingenuity#350.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#352.src: I work as her assistant in her workshop, help her with whatever projects she's working on, and in exchange she allows us to live in the station!
The Price of Ingenuity#352.dst: 그 여자 작업장에서 조수로 일하면서 무슨 프로젝트든 돕고, 그 대가로 우리가 역에서 살게 해 주는 거야!
The Price of Ingenuity#352.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#353.src: As long as we don't cause any trouble with soldiers, at least- which, might I remind you, you people caused? So don't- don't act like...
The Price of Ingenuity#353.dst: 적어도 병사들이랑 문제만 안 일으키면- 근데, 다시 말하지만, 그걸 일으킨 게 너희잖아? 그러니까- 그런 척하지 마...
The Price of Ingenuity#353.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#354.src: Oh my god, you idiot. How long were you planning to keep this a secret? Were you ever going to tell anyone?
The Price of Ingenuity#354.dst: 세상에, 이 바보야. 언제까지 숨길 생각이었어? 누구한테 말할 생각은 있었어?
The Price of Ingenuity#354.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#356.src: You were just gonna let it sit until, inevitably , someone was going to piss off the soldiers? Because, trust me, that would have happened eventually. With or without us.
The Price of Ingenuity#356.dst: 그냥 덮어 두다가 결국 누가 병사들 심기를 건드리길 기다렸어? 날 믿어, 그건 언젠가 터졌을 거야. 우리가 있든 없든.
The Price of Ingenuity#356.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#357.src: Status: On Hold. She needs my attention elsewhere.
The Price of Ingenuity#357.dst: 상태: 보류. 그녀는 내가 다른 일에 집중하길 원한다.

The Price of Ingenuity#359.src: Ack! You- you heard that part too?
The Price of Ingenuity#359.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#361.src: Ughhh.... I don't know! I don't know. I don't want to, obviously! You're all good people, and it'd break every single one of our guidelines to throw someone out like that!
The Price of Ingenuity#361.dst: 으으으.... 모르겠어! 모르겠다고. 당연히 하기 싫지! 너희 다 좋은 사람들이고, 그렇게 누굴 내쫓는 건 우리 원칙을 전부 어기는 거야!
The Price of Ingenuity#361.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#362.src: But... I don't think I have a choice. The Steel Feather's safety is on the line, and I could fix it by just- just- handing someone over, but- I- I can't. I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.dst: 근데... 선택지가 없는 것 같아. Steel Feather의 안전이 걸렸고, 누굴- 누굴- 넘기기만 하면 해결되지만- 난- 못 해. 그건 못 해.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#364.src: Okay. You were doing what you thought was right. I can understand that. But this - keeping secrets, following their rules - it was never going to end well!
The Price of Ingenuity#364.dst: 좋아. 넌 옳다고 믿는 걸 한 거야. 그건 이해해. 하지만 이거 - 비밀을 지키고 저들 규칙을 따르는 거 - 끝이 좋을 리 없었어!
The Price of Ingenuity#364.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#365.src: We can get past this choice by doing what we were already doing - trying to take down the crown! If we succeed, there won't be any more risk for you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.dst: 원래 하던 일을 하면 이 선택은 피할 수 있어 - 왕실을 무너뜨리는 거! 성공하면 너희한테 더는 위험도 없어.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#367.src: This is your chance to make it right, Yusanu! You have information. Tell us what you and the Sovereign were working on. Is it important?
The Price of Ingenuity#367.dst: 바로잡을 기회야, Yusanu! 넌 정보가 있잖아. 너랑 군주가 뭘 만들고 있었는지 말해. 중요한 거야?
The Price of Ingenuity#367.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#368.src: ...I don't know much about... what it is. I know it's not a weapon, at least- Soosu was clear on that. It's... an important assignment from the Queen.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.dst: ...그게... 뭔지는 잘 몰라. 적어도 무기는 아니야- Soosu가 분명히 말했어. 그건... 여왕이 맡긴 중요한 과제야.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#369.src: It's- it's strange. Very, very strange. It uses science that sounds... impossible. I think we're building over an existing device, something the Queen already had.
The Price of Ingenuity#369.dst: 그게- 이상해. 정말, 정말 이상해. 쓰는 과학이... 불가능하게 들려. 이미 있던 장치, 여왕이 원래 갖고 있던 걸 개조하는 것 같아.
The Price of Ingenuity#369.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#370.src: Soosu... she's stressed about the project. She needs to get it done, but it- it seems like an impossible task. There's something on the line for her.
The Price of Ingenuity#370.dst: Soosu는... 그 프로젝트 때문에 스트레스가 심해. 끝내야 하는데, 그게- 불가능한 일처럼 보여. 뭔가 걸려 있는 것 같아.
The Price of Ingenuity#370.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#371.src: ...mysterious device, important to the crown... got it. {u}, Yusanu- we need to steal it. If it's important to the crown... whatever it does, it's better if they don't have it.
The Price of Ingenuity#371.dst: ...왕실에 중요한 수수께끼 장치라... 알겠어. {u}, Yusanu- 그걸 훔치자. 왕실에 중요하다면... 뭘 하든 저들 손에 없는 게 나아.
The Price of Ingenuity#371.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#372.src: Wh- what?! You can't be serious! We can't just-
The Price of Ingenuity#372.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#373.src: We can, and we should! The Sovereigns aren't your friends, Yusanu, they're complicit in and responsible for everything wrong with Fruma!!
The Price of Ingenuity#373.dst: 할 수 있고, 해야 해! 군주들은 네 친구가 아니야, Yusanu. Fruma가 이 꼴이 된 모든 일의 공범이자 책임자라고!!
The Price of Ingenuity#373.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#374.src: If we can hurt them, then we can hurt the crown. And if we can hurt the crown... we might actually stand a chance.
The Price of Ingenuity#374.dst: 그들한테 타격을 주면 왕실에도 타격을 줄 수 있어. 그리고 왕실에 타격을 주면... 정말 승산이 생길지도 몰라.
The Price of Ingenuity#374.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#375.src: ...okay. Okay, fine! You're right. You're... right.
The Price of Ingenuity#375.dst: ...좋아. 좋아, 알았어! 네 말이 맞아. 네... 말이 맞아.
The Price of Ingenuity#375.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#376.src: I can get you to it. Uh... how did you get in, anyway?
The Price of Ingenuity#376.dst: 거기까지 데려다줄 수 있어. 어... 근데 어떻게 들어왔어?
The Price of Ingenuity#376.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#377.src: We'll show you. Come on, back in we go.
The Price of Ingenuity#377.dst: 보여 줄게. 가자, 다시 들어가는 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#377.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#381.src: Right, we'll need to be fast. Soosu tends to spend most of her time in the workshops...
The Price of Ingenuity#381.dst: 좋아, 서둘러야 해. Soosu는 대부분 작업장에서 시간을 보내거든...
The Price of Ingenuity#381.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#383.src: I... would probably be fine. But if she sees you two, then...
The Price of Ingenuity#383.dst: 난... 아마 괜찮겠지. 근데 너희 둘을 보면, 그땐...
The Price of Ingenuity#383.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#384.src: So don't get caught, got it. I'm guessing we wouldn't stand a chance fighting her?
The Price of Ingenuity#384.dst: 그러니까 잡히지 말라는 거지, 알겠어. 싸워서는 승산 없겠지?
The Price of Ingenuity#384.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#385.src: No!! No, no, absolutely not. Her blessing... I haven't seen her use it in combat, but knowing what it can do...
The Price of Ingenuity#385.dst: 없어!! 아니, 아니, 절대 없어. 그 여자 축복은... 전투에서 쓰는 건 못 봤지만, 뭘 할 수 있는지 알잖아...
The Price of Ingenuity#385.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#386.src: Being able to mold matter... it means more than just putting together machines. So...
The Price of Ingenuity#386.dst: 물질을 빚어낼 수 있다는 건... 그냥 기계 조립하는 것 이상이란 뜻이야. 그러니까...
The Price of Ingenuity#386.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#387.src: It won't come to that. Come on, let's get going.
The Price of Ingenuity#387.dst: 그렇게까진 안 될 거야. 가자, 출발하자.
The Price of Ingenuity#387.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#388.src: The door to the workshop has already been unlocked...
The Price of Ingenuity#388.dst: 작업장 문은 이미 잠금이 풀려 있다...

The Price of Ingenuity#392.src: Alright, before we descend - Soosu has a bunch of golems walking around her workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#392.dst: 좋아, 내려가기 전에 - Soosu 작업장엔 골렘들이 잔뜩 돌아다녀.
The Price of Ingenuity#392.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#393.src: They're more... uh, advanced than Sparkles and Glitter. If they see us, they'll sound the alarms. So don't get caught!
The Price of Ingenuity#393.dst: Sparkles랑 Glitter보다... 어, 고급형이야. 들키면 경보를 울릴 거야. 그러니 잡히지 마!
The Price of Ingenuity#393.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#394.src: How did you two even manage to find me?
The Price of Ingenuity#394.dst: 너희 둘 대체 날 어떻게 찾은 거야?
The Price of Ingenuity#394.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#395.src: Really? I'm... surprised the system held together long enough for that.
The Price of Ingenuity#395.dst: 진짜? 그동안 시스템이 버텨 준 게... 놀랍네.
The Price of Ingenuity#395.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#396.src: Look, it's not our fault this... thing doesn't come with an instruction manual!
The Price of Ingenuity#396.dst: 봐, 이... 물건에 사용 설명서가 없는 건 우리 잘못이 아니잖아!
The Price of Ingenuity#396.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#397.src: Ha! Okay, it's a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#397.dst: 하! 그래, 좀 헷갈리긴 해. 목적지를 고르고, 위나 아래를 누르고, 레버를 당겨서 켜면 돼! 간단하지.
The Price of Ingenuity#397.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#398.src: That... sounds right, but the way you say that is concerning. What actually happened?
The Price of Ingenuity#398.dst: 그거... 맞긴 한데 말하는 투가 걱정되네. 실제로 무슨 일이 있었어?
The Price of Ingenuity#398.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#399.src: Ugh, it doesn't matter what happened. What matters is this stupid box is overly complicated and annoying!
The Price of Ingenuity#399.dst: 으, 무슨 일이 있었는지는 중요하지 않아. 중요한 건 이 멍청한 상자가 쓸데없이 복잡하고 짜증 난다는 거야!
The Price of Ingenuity#399.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#400.src: Okay, okay! It is... a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.dst: 알았어, 알았어! 좀... 헷갈리긴 해. 목적지를 고르고, 위나 아래를 누르고, 레버를 당겨서 켜면 돼! 간단하지.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#401.src: ...I chose the music, by the way.
The Price of Ingenuity#401.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#403.src: Oh... I forgot how much of a mess it was down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.dst: 아... 여기 아래가 얼마나 난장판인지 잊고 있었네.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#404.src: Sneak through the mansion avoiding the guards.

The Price of Ingenuity#405.src: Alright! That's our goal, over there.
The Price of Ingenuity#405.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#406.src: It's the most important sector of Soosu's workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#407.src: Look around Soosu's workshop for the device.

The Price of Ingenuity#408.src: And you're sure she won't be coming down here?
The Price of Ingenuity#408.dst: 그 여자가 여기 안 내려오는 거 확실해?
The Price of Ingenuity#408.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#409.src: Uh... mostly. {~} sure. We should be fine today, if we move quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.dst: 어... 대체로. {~} 확신해. 빨리 움직이면 오늘은 괜찮을 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#411.src: The festival's coming up, so she has a lot to handle. She'll be busy cleaning up the other workshops, building whatever contraptions she needs for this year's festival... that sort of stuff.
The Price of Ingenuity#411.dst: 축제가 다가와서 처리할 일이 많거든. 다른 작업장을 정리하고 올해 축제에 쓸 장치를 만드느라 바쁠 거야... 그런 일들.
The Price of Ingenuity#411.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#412.src: She only comes down here for the big projects. Well, or when she needs to let out some steam. But she doesn't have anything going on today, so... we're safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#412.dst: 여긴 큰 프로젝트 때만 내려와. 음, 아니면 화풀이가 필요할 때나. 근데 오늘은 진행 중인 게 없으니까... 안전해.
The Price of Ingenuity#412.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#413.src: ...if you say so, Yusanu. Still, I'd rather be out of here quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.dst: ...네가 그렇다면야, Yusanu. 그래도 빨리 나가고 싶어.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#414.src: Yeah... same. Let's take the device and go.
The Price of Ingenuity#414.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#415.src: This is Soosu's favorite room in the workshop. Her golem creation room.
The Price of Ingenuity#415.dst: 여긴 Soosu가 작업장에서 제일 좋아하는 방이야. 골렘 제작실이지.
The Price of Ingenuity#415.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#416.src: She... told me once that she likes working with plants. It's why a lot of her golems are built off of flower pots and soil.
The Price of Ingenuity#416.dst: 그 여자가... 식물 다루는 게 좋다고 한 적 있어. 그래서 골렘 상당수가 화분이랑 흙으로 만들어졌어.
The Price of Ingenuity#416.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#417.src: Hm. Well, good thing she's using her blessing on this, and not... I don't know. Reshaping the whole world?
The Price of Ingenuity#417.dst: 흠. 뭐, 축복을 이런 데 써서 다행이네. 안 그랬으면... 모르겠다. 온 세상을 다시 빚었으려나?
The Price of Ingenuity#417.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#418.src: A-another golem? Should we turn back?
The Price of Ingenuity#418.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#419.src: Oh, hey, it's Flowers! That's Soosu's favourite golem! Wonder why he's sleeping here and not on his Flowersbed, though. ... I wasn't the one that named that.
The Price of Ingenuity#419.dst: 오, 이봐, Flowers잖아! Soosu가 제일 아끼는 골렘이야! 근데 왜 Flowers침대가 아니라 여기서 자지? ... 이름은 내가 지은 거 아니야.
The Price of Ingenuity#419.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#420.src: Finally!!! He said yes!!! Uncle T finally let me visit his workshop, I'm so excited!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.dst: 드디어!!! 허락받았다!!! T 삼촌이 드디어 작업장 구경을 시켜 준대, 너무 신나!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#421.src: He's real!! Flowers is REAL NOW!!!! I showed Ma my drawing, and she helped me sew him together!! Now I can match with Fiona! She has Daruma, and I have... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.dst: 진짜야!! Flowers가 이제 진짜야!!!! 엄마한테 그림 보여 줬더니 같이 꿰매 줬어!! 이제 Fiona랑 짝이다! 걔는 Daruma, 나는... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#422.src: Hmph. Hmph!!!!!!!! Fiona's old enough now, she's gotta work too... she's always so tired now, she won't play with me anymore!!!! This sucks. This sucks!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.dst: 흥. 흥!!!!!!!! Fiona도 이제 일할 나이래... 맨날 너무 피곤하대서 이제 나랑 안 놀아 줘!!!! 짜증 나. 짜증 나!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#423.src: Uncle T agreed to help me make the super ultra cow milker o-matic!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.dst: T 삼촌이 초울트라 자동 소젖 짜기 머신 만드는 걸 도와준대!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#425.src: Grrrrrr............ I haven't written in AGES......... and it's because I gotta WORK!!!! In the FIELDS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#425.dst: 크르르르르............ 일기 쓴 지 한참 됐어......... 일해야 돼서야!!!! 밭에서!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#425.speaker: 127 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#426.src: I've been READING!! Reading so so many books... about FARMING!
The Price of Ingenuity#426.dst: 책 읽었어!! 책을 엄청엄청 많이... 농사에 대한 거!
The Price of Ingenuity#426.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#427.src: It's that time of year again!! The FESTIVAL OF THE CROWN!!! Just a week away!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#427.dst: 또 그때가 왔다!! 왕관 축제!!! 딱 일주일 남았어!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#427.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#428.src: Weird thing happened today. Uncle T came home with a strange man from the military, big ol fancy uniform and all!
The Price of Ingenuity#428.dst: 오늘 이상한 일이 있었어. T 삼촌이 군대에서 온 이상한 아저씨를 데려왔어, 엄청 화려한 제복 입고!
The Price of Ingenuity#428.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#429.src: It turns out, the Crown really liked my super duper farmer!! Cause it makes it easier to harvest crops and stuff, they want us to make more of them, so everyone can do their work faster!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.dst: 알고 보니 왕실이 내 초특급 농사 기계를 엄청 좋아했대!! 수확 같은 게 쉬워져서 더 만들래, 다들 일을 더 빨리 하게!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#430.src: Ugh...... ughhhhhhhh......... UGHHHHHHH...... I'm so TIRED!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#431.src: Uncle T got really hurt today. Really, really, really hurt.
The Price of Ingenuity#431.dst: T 삼촌이 오늘 많이 다쳤어. 정말, 정말, 정말 많이.
The Price of Ingenuity#431.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#432.src: Ma says Uncle T's gonna be okay. He will.
The Price of Ingenuity#432.dst: 엄마가 T 삼촌은 괜찮을 거래. 괜찮을 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#432.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#435.src: The Citadel was AWESOME!!! I've always dreamed of going up there, someday... and now I HAVE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#435.dst: Citadel 최고였어!!! 언젠가 꼭 올라가 보고 싶었는데... 드디어 갔다!!
The Price of Ingenuity#435.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#436.src: Work on project E-lec-tricity is ongoing (yes, the name changed... the Sovereign didn't like what I called it before...... bleh.), and it's going really well!!
The Price of Ingenuity#436.dst: 전-기 프로젝트 진행 중 (그래, 이름 바뀜... 군주님이 원래 이름 싫대...... 칫.), 진짜 잘되고 있어!!
The Price of Ingenuity#436.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#437.src: OKAY!!! DO NOT PANIC!!!! BUT THINGS! ARE! HAPPENING!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.dst: 좋아!!! 당황하지 마!!!! 근데 일이! 벌어! 지고 있어!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.speaker: 130 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#439.src: Looking back at these entries, I... I feel hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#439.speaker: 3 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#440.src: Mother passed away from her illness, a few days ago. They knew it was coming for a while, apparently, but... it was still a shock.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.dst: 어머니가 며칠 전 병으로 돌아가셨다. 다들 오래전부터 알았다지만... 그래도 충격이었다.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.speaker: 4 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#441.src: What's the point in writing these, anymore? I don't know what to say. I could talk about my projects, about all the progress I've been making, but it all feels so hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#441.dst: 이제 이걸 써서 뭐 하나? 무슨 말을 해야 할지 모르겠다. 프로젝트나 그간의 진척을 쓸 수도 있지만, 전부 허망하게 느껴진다.
The Price of Ingenuity#441.speaker: 10 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#442.src: How many years has it been? I can check the dates, but... I don't want to.
The Price of Ingenuity#442.dst: 몇 년이나 지났을까? 날짜를 확인할 수는 있지만... 그러고 싶지 않다.
The Price of Ingenuity#442.speaker: 40 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#443.src: Never forget, never stop creating, never give in!
The Price of Ingenuity#443.dst: 절대 잊지 말고, 멈추지 말고 만들고, 절대 굴복하지 마라!
The Price of Ingenuity#443.speaker: 45 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#444.src: And there it is... looking at it like this, it really is impressive.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.dst: 저기 있다... 이렇게 보니 정말 대단하네.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#445.src: Again, you really don't know what this is for? And more importantly, which of us will carry it out?
The Price of Ingenuity#445.dst: 다시 묻는데, 이게 뭐에 쓰는 건지 진짜 몰라? 그리고 더 중요한 건, 누가 들고 나가지?
The Price of Ingenuity#445.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#446.src: I'd say until we're in the clear, {u} should carry it. And no... I really, absolutely do not. Every time I've asked Soosu to elaborate, she's just blown me off.
The Price of Ingenuity#446.dst: 안전해질 때까진 {u}이(가) 드는 게 좋겠어. 그리고 아니... 정말, 전혀 몰라. Soosu한테 자세히 물을 때마다 얼버무렸어.
The Price of Ingenuity#446.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#447.src: Well. Whatever this is, it can't be any good if the Crown wants it. {u}, are you ready?
The Price of Ingenuity#447.dst: 뭐. 이게 뭐든 왕실이 원한다면 좋은 건 아니겠지. {u}, 준비됐어?
The Price of Ingenuity#447.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#448.src: Wait. Do you also hear that sound? Are those footsteps?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#449.src: Can't be anything else - and there's two pairs of them. So Soosu is here, but with whom...?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.dst: 그것밖에 없지 - 게다가 두 사람이야. Soosu가 왔는데, 누구랑...?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#450.src: ...are you sure this is the best idea? Dividing your attention between the discussion, and your...projects... It hasn't worked out in the past.
The Price of Ingenuity#450.dst: ...이게 최선이라고 확신해? 토론과 네... 프로젝트에 주의를 나누는 거 말이야... 전에도 잘된 적 없잖아.
The Price of Ingenuity#450.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#451.src: Well, you know, Zhiraok, not eeeveryone seems to have the time to drop everything and leave their region. Sometimes, we have a job to do.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.dst: 음, 있잖아, Zhiraok, 모오오든 사람이 다 내팽개치고 자기 구역을 떠날 시간이 있는 건 아니거든. 우리도 할 일이 있어.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#452.src: Ah, there you are, Flowers! Wakey wakey, sleepyhead - you've got some guarding to get back to!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.dst: 아, 거기 있었구나, Flowers! 일어나, 잠꾸러기야 - 경비 서러 돌아가야지!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#454.src: Awareness, Soosu! A bit of warning before you stop like that?
The Price of Ingenuity#454.dst: 주의력, Soosu! 그렇게 멈추기 전에 경고 좀 해 줄래?
The Price of Ingenuity#454.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#455.src: Hm? Ah, sorry, sorry, but an unexpected run-in with a close friend is just sooo nice! Surely there's space somewhere in your mind to know that, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#455.dst: 응? 아, 미안, 미안, 근데 친한 친구랑 우연히 마주치는 건 너어어무 좋잖아! 네 머릿속에도 그걸 알 자리는 있겠지, 응?
The Price of Ingenuity#455.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#456.src: Soosu... This is a solved problem! How many times have I told you that? ...Alright, look, that's a tangent. What I really need to tell you-
The Price of Ingenuity#456.dst: Soosu... 그건 이미 풀린 문제잖아! 내가 몇 번을 말했어? ...좋아, 봐, 이건 곁가지야. 내가 진짜 해야 할 말은-
The Price of Ingenuity#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#457.src: Escape the workshop without being spotted.

The Price of Ingenuity#458.src: Soosu's here? And with Zhiraok, of all people?! We have to get out, now!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.dst: Soosu가 왔어? 그것도 하필 Zhiraok랑?! 당장 나가야 해!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#459.src: Yeah, but I bet Soosu's got Flowers on high alert! Don't use your magic, and whatever you do, don't get spotted!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.dst: 응, 근데 Soosu가 Flowers를 비상 경계로 바꿨을 거야! 마법 쓰지 말고, 무슨 일이 있어도 들키지 마!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#460.src: Wait- What's that, Flowers? Intruders?! Right by the device room?!
The Price of Ingenuity#460.dst: 잠깐- 뭐라고, Flowers? 침입자?! 장치실 바로 옆에?!
The Price of Ingenuity#460.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#461.src: ...!! The Cursed!! You're not laying one digit on her, you hear me?!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.dst: ...!! 저주받은 자!! 그녀한테 손끝 하나 못 댄다, 알아들어?!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#462.src: Wh-what the helix Infiltrators! You aren't getting away this time!
The Price of Ingenuity#462.dst: 뭐, 뭐야 이 나선 같은 침입자들! 이번엔 못 빠져나간다!
The Price of Ingenuity#462.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#463.src: Yusanu?! Who is that with you? Wait, are you trying to steal the device?!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.dst: Yusanu?! 같이 있는 건 누구야? 잠깐, 설마 장치를 훔치려는 거야?!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#464.src: Hello, we're meant to run! Are you even taking this seriously?!
The Price of Ingenuity#464.dst: 저기요, 우리 도망쳐야 하거든! 진지하게 하는 거 맞아?!
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: ...you're smart enough that I shouldn't need to reiterate this! I know you are! Please, take the problem seriously!
